# APK signature fixtures

These APKs come from the Android Open Source Project `platform/tools/apksig`
test suite at commit `bb12ed7f06eb3f702cb03006643169db7e1c811d` and are
distributed under Apache-2.0. The license text is available at
`options/license/Apache-2.0` in this repository.

- `valid-v1v2v3.apk`: `golden-aligned-v1v2v3-out.apk`
- `unsigned.apk`: `pinsapp-unsigned.apk`
- `multiple-signers.apk`: `v2-only-two-signers.apk`
- `rotated-signing-key.apk`: `v1v2v3-with-rsa-2048-lineage-3-signers.apk`
- `invalid-signature.apk`: `v2-only-with-rsa-pkcs1-sha256-2048-sig-does-not-verify.apk`
